disorder-name.detail: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder; ADHD-200 dataset evaluated with the normative model for ADHD dimensional scores (inattentive, hyperactive/impulsive, ADHD index). PD=38.7% (ADHD subtypes).

disorder-name.detail: Dimensional psychopathology measured by CBCL (Child Behavior Checklist) symptom groups. Two datasets evaluated: BHRCS (n=737, high-risk cohort, out-of-sample) and ABCD test set (n=3,524, from the same study dataset split). Both datasets assessed for CBCL symptom group correlations (aggressive behavior, anxious/depressed, attention problems, rule-breaking, somatic complaints, social problems, thought problems, withdrawn/internalizing/externalizing/total). PD=30.5% in BHRCS (DSM-IV); PD=15.0% in full ABCD (DSM-V). Combined N applied to NM: 3,524 (ABCD test set) + 737 (BHRCS) = 4,261.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "For the BHRCS dataset (n = 737), the predicted likelihood of typicality of whole brains has not presented significant correlations to psychiatric symptoms after statistical corrections." and "During the evaluation of the ABCD test set (n = 3,524), the whole-brain predicted likelihood of typicality presented a statistically significant correlation with CBCL's social problems scale"

dataset-of-origin.detail: ABCD (Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development): full dataset n=11,031, test subset n=3,524 applied to NM, collected from 21 sites in USA with multi-brand 3T scanners, PD=15.0% (DSM-V). BHRCS (Brazilian High-Risk Cohort Study): n=737, collected from 2 Brazilian cities with 1.5T scanners, PD=30.5% (DSM-IV).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Brazilian High-Risk Cohort Study (BHRCS, n = 737) and Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD, n = 11,031)" ... "The ABCD test set (n= 3,524) and the complete datasets of ABIDE-II (n= 580), ADHD-200 (n= 922), and BHRCS (n= 737) were reserved for the evaluation procedure"
